SYNTHETIC DOCUMENT (created for conflict demonstration)
Circular No. ACAD-2026-08
Office of the Dean (Academics)
Subject: Revised minimum attendance requirement
Effective 1 August 2026. This circular supersedes clause 7.2 of the Academic Regulations for B.Tech Programmes.

1. Revised attendance requirement
With effect from 1 August 2026, a student must have a minimum of 80% attendance in each course to be eligible to appear in the end-semester examination.

2. Condonation under clause 7.3 of the Academic Regulations remains unchanged.
